notes: The Map is a terrain map you can move and zoom. China is a raised slab of painted country (snowy plateau, desert, grassland, forest, farmland, rivers, the Great Wall) in a sea with junks. Drag to move it, pinch or use + and - to zoom, double tap to zoom in. Tap a monument and the map flies to it and a card names it. What is not built yet stays a secret: a level with no words is a cloud with a question mark, and no outlines or names of pieces to come are shown
